messages:
Sam P: Hey folks — quick question. I joined last Tues (3/3) and my benefits portal still shows ‘pending’ for health coverage. My previous employer's COBRA ended last Friday and I need to know the effective date. Also I paid movers and bought boxes — can I submit those moving receipts for relocation reimbursement? thanks!

HR Bot: Thanks for reaching out, Sam! Maya will follow up. In the meantime, you can check the portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/portal (note: hire-date rules apply).

Maya (People Ops): Hi Sam — welcome! For standard hires our default health effective date is the first of the month after your hire date. Since you started 2026-03-03 your coverage would normally be effective 2026-04-01. We can request a retroactive start to 2026-03-01 if your prior coverage lapsed, but we need proof of termination (COBRA/termination letter). Can you DM or email that to benefits@redwood.com?

Sam P: Thanks — my last coverage end date is 2026-02-28. I'll upload the termination PDF. Quick Q on moving receipts: the relocation policy mentions ‘reasonable moving costs’ — are packing supplies like boxes covered?

Maya (People Ops): Packing supplies are usually not covered unless they're on the mover's invoice. However, we do approve spot reimbursements for small expenses (boxes, tape) on a case-by-case basis. Please send scanned receipts plus a short justification. For reimbursements follow the finance process below.

Juan (Payroll): FYI from payroll: if we approve a retroactive benefits start the cost will be handled as a benefits adjustment and should show up on the payroll run after approval (payroll cutoff is Thu 5pm PST). Moving reimbursements should be submitted via Expensify under category "Relocation" so they route to the right queue.

Sam P: Got it. Where do I submit? I don't see "Relocation" in my Expensify categories.

Maya (People Ops): If Relocation isn't in your Expensify yet, email benefits@redwood.com with receipts and we will create the ticket manually. Use this subject format so Finance can triage quickly: 

Relocation Reimburse - Sam P - [date]

Example email body you can copy/paste:

```
To: benefits@redwood.com
Subject: Relocation Reimburse - Sam P - 2026-03-10

Hi benefits team,
Please find attached receipts for moving blankets and mover invoice. Total: $432.50
Reason: One-time relocation due to role
Attachments: mover_invoice.pdf, boxes_receipt.jpg
Thanks,
Sam P
```

Finance Bot: Note: Per policy, individual non-mover receipts > $500 require prior approval. Approved reimbursements normally process within two payroll cycles after approval. Also, if you want a tax gross-up, say so in the email and include your manager's approval.

Lina K: Welcome Sam! If you want I can jump on a quick screen share to help upload the termination letter and receipts to the portal. Happy to help.

Sam P: Uploaded termination letter and receipts to benefits@redwood.com just now. Thanks everyone! :heart:

HR Bot: We received your submission, Sam. Benefits team will review and reply within 2 business days. (Ticket #BR-2026-0312)
